Subject: QBR demo: rotating slot proposal + stakeholder ops

Hi Sophie —

We’re prepping the renewal/expansion QBR + roadmap demo for Acme and want to make sure the session is accessible to stakeholders across EMEA / US / APAC without forcing everyone into one awkward hour. Proposal below is a lightweight rotating-slot approach so we can:

- run the same demo content three times spread across a 48-hour window (same slides, same demo environment)
- alternate which stakeholders join each slot so execs and engineers attend the right session
- keep one backup slot in case of last-minute schedule conflicts

Quick asks: can you share the list of required attendees (exec, platform, security, deployment) and any strict blackout windows? Also let me know if your security engineer (for the short architecture Q&A) should join the main demo or a follow-up deep dive.

Attached: QBR_agenda.pdf (draft). I’ll follow up with a filled-in slot grid after I get attendee constraints.

Proposed high-level rotation (will formalize once you confirm):
- Slot A: EMEA-friendly (10:30–11:30 CET) — product + ops + exec rep
- Slot B: US-friendly (16:00–17:00 CET / 08:00–09:00 PT) — solutions + procurement + AM
- Slot C: APAC-friendly (08:00–09:00 CET / 15:00–16:00 SGT) — engineering + security deep-dive

If that looks reasonable I’ll draft calendar invites and suggest attendees per slot.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_agenda.pdf

Hi Olga — thanks for the thoughtful approach. Really appreciate trying to avoid a single late-night option for some of our folks. A few constraints from our side:

- Execs (me + CTO Michelle Park) prefer late morning CET (10:00–12:00).
- Our platform lead (Paul Nguyen) is flexible but needs a heads-up 48h in advance. He should be on the architecture Q&A.
- Security (Samir Patel) cannot do the first week of December afternoons — he asked for mornings CET only.
- APAC (Sydney office) can only attend after 14:00 SGT on weekdays; they’ll likely join a recording if we can’t match that.

Participants I’ll confirm:
- Sophie Turner — Head of Partnerships / Acme Analytics
- Michelle Park — CTO (exec)
- Paul Nguyen — Platform Lead (paul.nguyen@acmeanalytics.com)
- Samir Patel — InfoSec (samir.patel@acmeanalytics.com)

If we’re doing three live slots I think: keep Slot A at 10:30 CET for execs, Slot B in your daytime US window, and Slot C do a recorded/APAC-friendly on-demand + live tech Q&A later (Samir wants the live tech Q&A).

Happy for Redwood to propose exact times and send calendar invites. Can you also add a quick note with the expected demo runtime and any pre-reqs (e.g., access level for live walkthrough)?

— Sophie
Acme Analytics

Proposed schedule (same demo content, tailored attendee list per slot):
- Slot 1 — Exec/Strategy: Tue 8 Dec — 10:30–11:15 CET (45 min) — Sophie, Michelle (CTO), Laura (AM), Olga (lead)
- Slot 2 — US Ops & Procurement: Tue 8 Dec — 16:00–17:00 CET (60 min) — procurement + solutions + Vivek (solutions engineer)
- Slot 3 — Tech + Security Q&A: Wed 9 Dec — 09:30–10:30 CET (60 min) — Paul (platform), Samir (InfoSec), Rafael (solutions backup)

Estimated run times: 45–60 minutes (core demo 25–30 min, roadmap 10 min, Q&A 15–20 min). Pre-reqs: attendees who want to try the live console should have viewer access to the demo environment (I’ll send a short access link + credentials).

Attachments: QBR_demo_slot_grid_v2.xlsx (slot-by-slot attendee suggestions), qbr_demo_invite.ics (placeholder invite).

Links: HubSpot record and the QBR slide deck are here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3cQBRdeck

If this looks good I’ll:
1) send calendar invites for the three slots (incl. dial-in and recordings),
2) add a short pre-demo checklist for attendees, and
3) schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with Samir if he prefers to separate that from the main tech slot.

If you’d rather combine the security deep-dive into Slot 3 we can extend by 30 min.

— Olga
